name: Grade 7 Christian Religious Education Term 1 Exam
subject: Christian Religious Education

items.question: Who led the Israelites out of Egypt?
How many disciples did Jesus choose?
The first book of the Bible is?

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (46 marks)
items: 1. State the two main divisions of the Bible. (2 marks)
2. Name the first five books of the Old Testament. (5 marks)
3. State two values taught in the parable of the Good Samaritan. (2 marks)
4. What is the meaning of 'repentance'? (2 marks)
5. Name two prophets in the Old Testament. (2 marks)
